name: @access/demo
description: Records the demo video with Playwright against the demo team (AGENTS.md §5).

scripts.mp4: if command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null; then ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/access-pr-demo.webm -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 20 -movflags +faststart out/access-pr-demo.mp4 && echo 'Saved out/access-pr-demo.mp4'; else echo 'Install ffmpeg for an .mp4 copy (brew install ffmpeg).'; fi
